assumptions.description: Task fixes eight cells375 each; uniform integer ages inside bands, deterministic unique fictional identifiers.

US/Taiwan/German/Italian source relationships transfer to Mexico analytical eligibility without calibrated uncertainty. No source matches all fasting/anthropometry/pregnancy/medication/anemia restrictions; target is not national-survey representative.
Identity numeric units for external plasma glucose and task serum glucose, HbA1c assays, BMI measurement; no empirically validated assay or plasma-serum correction.
Lognormal BMI with NHANES mean and SHIP-Trend log-IQR spread; independent of age and sex. No upper cap; shape and cross-population pooling are assumptions, not exact source fit.

Conditional normal location age slope .15 and BMI slope .40, no female term, conditioned0<glucose<126; these dependence slopes are assumptions. Age rise only qualitatively informed by Pani. Do not reject/resample covariates upon glucose selection.

Untruncated analytic source surrogate with ageSD14.6, independent BMI/age/sex, female probability.5 and BMI mean28.01/derived variance; permits algebraic residual variances and marginal-slope subtraction but is not source-population reconstruction.
Negate Huang male-v-female age-only adjusted coefficient and transport as female effect in richer conditional HbA1c mean, omitting age-sex interaction/nonlinearity.

Direct HbA1c BMI term .010 is an assumption rounded from ecological guide .00964983119. Equal HGI-tertile covariance calculation supposes zero within-group adjusted-outcome covariance; it does not identify individual adjusted association.

Linear arithmetic conditional HbA1c mean; conditional lognormal with constant arithmetic residualSD. No HbA1c cutoff. Source mean/SD and equation slope prioritized; incompatible intercept/r not fitted. Residuals are individual variation, not model/evidence uncertainty.

Only NumPy,pandas,math; bounded sampler attempts10000. Central normal rejection and exact real-arithmetic truncated-exponential tail envelope; numerical unrepresentability or exhaustion raises visible failure. Never clip endpoints, cap/resample BMI, or substitute a distribution.

Feedback on target rows is approximate source comparison, not replay. Apply expressible source age/glucose/HbA1c selection where specified; omitted risk/treatment/anemia selection and different age/sex design remain. Survey weighting/nonidentity transforms/unknown quantiles/rich HGI context stay unavailable. Raw discrepancies not independent validity tests.

hba1c_female_slope.derivation: Negate reported male coefficient: -0.08301; transport to richer conditional model is assumed.

hba1c_bmi_slope.derivation: Equal-tertile Cov(B,H-.0158G-.01A)/[mean(SD_B²)+Var(Bmeans)]=.009649831190533023; rounded to assumed individual term.010, without identifying an empirical adjusted coefficient.

hba1c_glucose_slope.derivation: .0158-[.010*.15*14.6²+.010*.40*24.240169976197524]/121=.012356192728059587. Derived conditional coefficient only under surrogate covariance assumptions.

hba1c_residual_sd.derivation: sqrt(.4²-[(.010+.15*bG)²*14.6²+(.010+.40*bG)²*VB+bG²*Var(eG)+.08301²*.25]); residual variance.10576591480905888. Conditional lognormal preserves mean and variance.

sampler_attempt_limit.derivation: Mechanical termination bound10000 per draw/subdraw, with explicit failure. No scientific truncation is introduced.
